posts.text: Speaking to Al Mayadeen, Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister for Legal and International Affairs Kazem Gharibabadi said Tehran would consider the blockade an act of war and take all measures it deems necessary in response. He said the United States had resorted to military action twice and suffered a heavy defeat, warning that Washington could repeat the military option if it sought an even greater defeat. Gharibabadi said that if Washington were acting rationally, it would abandon the military option and pursue diplomacy with Iran. He added that Tehran continued to maintain contacts and exchange messages, but was not relying on diplomacy alone and remained prepared for all scenarios.

🇮🇱 🇸🇾 IDF ramps up incursions into Syria, scouts vital water basin Israel launched fresh ground operations in the Quneitra countryside in southern Syria on Saturday, making incursions into two local villages. Sources told Al Bawaba News a young man was shot in the village of Bariqa, one of the targeted villages. No further details were provided about his condition or the circumstances leading to his shooting. Separately, the IDF set up a checkpoint on a road between two towns in Quneitra’s north near the Golan Heights’ UN peacekeeping zone. Intensive Israeli reconnaissance flights were also reported over the Yarmouk Basin in the western Daraa countryside. The area contains important water resources, dams, and fertile farmland. Yarmouk Basin water talks between Syria and neighboring Jordan took up special urgency this year after Israel refused to renew a landmark 2021 water-sharing agreement it had with Amman . The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights has counted 97 Israeli incursions into Syria from November 1-20, including raids, arrests, gunfire, shelling, movement restrictions, and land-clearing/excavation operations. The Syrian government has paid lip-service to condemning Israel’s activities, but seems more focused on cracking down on rebellious minorities and sending military advisors to Saudi Arabia than securing its own borders. 👍 Substack | Chat | @geopolitics_prime

Kulbergs also highlighted increased hybrid attacks on NATO's eastern flank, alleging Russian intelligence services are behind preparations for an assault on an Estonian facility supporting Ukraine. He firmly ruled out restoring normal relations with Moscow even after a ceasefire in Ukraine, declaring a "new era" has begun.
